# Initial Set Up
```{r}
# uncomment for mac 
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
Sys.setenv(RGL_USE_NULL = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(qpcR)
set.seed(13)
```


# Reading in Data
```{r}
# reading in original data
team_stats <- read.csv('../data/TeamStatistics.csv')

# formatting data as monthly averages of free throw 
fta_monthly <- team_stats %>%
  # only looking at Regular Season games
  filter(gameType == "Regular Season", teamName == "Warriors") %>%
  
  # formatting as monthly events
  mutate(year_month = floor_date(as_date(gameDate), "month")) %>%
  group_by(year_month) %>%
  
  # average fta per month
  summarise(fta_monthly = mean(teamScore, na.rm = T),
            n_games = n()) %>%
  
  # filtering out seasons before year 1980 and after 2019
  filter(year_month >= "2000-10-1", year_month < "2019-10-1") %>%
  
  mutate(m = month(year_month), 
         season = if_else(m >= 10, year(year_month), year(year_month) - 1L))
```
## which months to drop
```{r}
table(fta_monthly$m)
```

drop 5, 10
5 and 10 don't have many appearances compared to the other months
done to simplify project

```{r}
ts_fta <- fta_monthly %>%
  filter(!(m %in% c(5,10))) %>%
  arrange(year_month) %>%
  pull(fta_monthly) %>% 
  ts()
```

## Splitting Data Into Training/Testing Sets
```{r}
ts_train <- ts_fta[1:119]
ts_test <- ts_fta[120:125]
```

We will be predicting the 2019 regular season free throw attempts.
